industries.title: Industries we serve
industries.intro: Most of our work is in plants where temperature, time, dose or position decides product quality.

items.title: One team, design to start-up
items.text: The engineer who designs your control system also programs it and commissions it. Nothing is lost between teams.

items.title: Five platforms, no brand bias
items.text: Siemens, Schneider Electric, Delta, LS Electric and Wecon. We recommend the platform that fits your budget, your spare parts and your maintenance team.

items.title: Screens your operators understand
items.text: HMI screens in Arabic, English or both, with clear alarms, manual and automatic modes, and recipes operators can select.

items.title: Tested and documented
items.text: Every I/O point, interlock and alarm is checked before production. You receive drawings and notes your maintenance team can use.

foreignBand.title: A local engineering team for your new plant
foreignBand.text: We commission imported lines, run I/O and loop checks, build Arabic HMIs for local operators and support the plant after start-up.

items.q: Which PLC brands do you work with?
items.a: We program and integrate Siemens, Schneider Electric, Delta, LS Electric and Wecon. We also commission and support machines that arrive with other controllers, after we review their documentation.

items.q: Do you build the control panel as well?
items.a: Yes. We produce the electrical design, assemble and wire the panel, and test it with the PLC program before it goes to site.

items.q: Can you work on a machine that has no drawings or program?
items.a: Yes. We trace the wiring, document the inputs and outputs, and write a new program if the old one cannot be used.

items.q: Can the HMI screens be in Arabic?
items.a: Yes. We design HMI screens in Arabic, English or both. One of our {link:projects/shampoo-filling-delta-wecon|shampoo filling machines} runs on Arabic screens for its local operators.

items.q: Do you work outside Greater Cairo?
items.a: Yes. We are based in 6th of October City and work across Egypt's industrial zones, including 10th of Ramadan, Sadat City, Borg El Arab and the Suez Canal Economic Zone.

items.q: What does the price of a control system depend on?
items.a: On the number of inputs and outputs, the PLC and HMI platform, the panel size and components, how much programming and testing is needed, and where the site is. Send a short description and photos, and an engineer replies with questions, a site visit or a quote.

items.q: How do I get a quote?
items.a: Use the quote form or send us a WhatsApp message with a short description and photos of the machine, the panel and the nameplates. An engineer will reply with questions, a site visit or a quote.
